findings.title: Require exact integer wait status rather than numeric equality
findings.confirmed_behavior: check_receipt accepts boolFalse/float0.0 as successful actual_p_wait or CompletedProcess returncode; raw_success_receipt likewise. check_failed_receipt accepts boolTrue/float1.0 as original failure1. Proven with in-memory stubs; no qualified artifact generated.
findings.impact: Invalid scalar receipt types can pass the generic physical/proof/SYN success or preserved-failure gates, contrary to normal exact-int policy. Actual nonzero integer failures remain rejected.
findings.suggestion: Use type(value) is int with exact0/1 and normal flag isTrue at common and direct wait entry points. Owner has been notified and is fixing separately.
